## FASB Accounting Standards Codification

Financial Accounting Standards Board · US · **account required — cite it; the user fetches it**

<https://asc.fasb.org/>

**Authoritative for:** US GAAP as it actually reads — revenue recognition, leases, impairment. The Basic View is free with an account and the text is copyrighted: cite the ASC number, do not reproduce the wording.

## Internal Revenue Bulletin

US Internal Revenue Service · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.irs.gov/irb>

**Authoritative for:** The IRS's own authoritative announcements — revenue rulings, revenue procedures, notices. Where a position has to be supported rather than described, this is what supports it.
